title: gapbench: Leakage-safe benchmarking of gap handling for annual heat extremes and river-temperature trends
description: gapbench is an MIT-licensed Python package for leakage-safe benchmarking of gap handling in annual heat-extreme and river-temperature records. It provides joint archive-level gap masks, fitting-period and evaluation separation, annual recovery and trend scoring, calendar-only year selection, slope-error decomposition, group-disjoint splits, and a synthetic quickstart, with an associated EMS case study. This deposit is software only: it does not redistribute observational data or establish reservoir causation. No archival DOI, GitHub release, or v1.2.0 git tag exists yet; the historical v1.0.0 tag is not this version.
